You build something valuable — an ebook, a course, a Notion template, a font family, a preset pack, a beat — and someone pays you for access to it. The file transfers. The transaction completes. But for millions of creators, the payment layer is where everything breaks down. Stripe is unavailable. PayPal flags the account. Gumroad holds the payout. The workarounds stop working. What actually works is a sovereign commerce stack: a static storefront on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, automatic payment verification through NOWPayments, and delivery triggered by a webhook the moment the transaction confirms on-chain. No platform intermediary. No payout schedule. No geography filter. The customer owns the storefront code, the order history, the customer list, and the product files. COREMERCH has no access after deployment.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-what-actually-how-16. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Music online

The infrastructure for selling digital products, such as ebooks, courses, or music, without relying on traditional payment gateways is based on combining free and paid tools to create a sovereign digital commerce stack. This stack includes hosting, backend logic, order storage, file delivery, and crypto payment processing, ensuring full data ownership and minimal fees. For instance, using NOWPayments for crypto transactions charges only 0.5% per sale, significantly less than Gumroad's 10% fee.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a sovereign digital commerce stack is designed to be efficient and cost-effective. It utilizes GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Additionally, integrating NOWPayments enables automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with support for over 300 cryptocurrencies, making it a robust solution for creators worldwide. This setup allows for the automation of product delivery and payment processing without the need for intermediaries like Stripe or PayPal.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are unavailable or severely restricted. It empowers them to sell their products, such as ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software, directly to their audience without incurring high platform fees. By using a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators maintain full control over their business and customer data, ensuring a more sustainable and independent entrepreneurial journey.
Sovereign digital commerce empowers creators to sell globally without platform restrictions.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of a sovereign digital commerce stack work in harmony to provide a seamless experience for both creators and their customers. For example, Cloudflare Workers can automate the delivery of digital products upon successful payment confirmation from NOWPayments, while Supabase securely stores order information for future reference. This integrated approach minimizes the complexity of managing a digital storefront, allowing creators to focus on producing high-quality content.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack today, creators can start by selecting the appropriate tools for each component based on their specific needs and technical comfort level. They can then integrate these tools, ensuring that each part of the stack communicates effectively with the others. For those looking for a comprehensive solution, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers all the necessary blueprints and templates to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack, providing instant access to the tools needed to start selling digital products without platform restrictions.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees is by leveraging a sovereign digital commerce stack that integrates crypto payment processing, automates product delivery, and ensures full data ownership. This approach not only minimizes fees but also provides creators with the independence to manage their digital storefronts without relying on intermediaries. For instance, at 100 sales per month of a $97 product, using NOWPayments instead of Gumroad would retain $921 due to the significant difference in transaction fees.
NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction, significantly less than traditional platforms.

By visiting https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, one can explore solutions like the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates necessary for building and scaling a digital commerce infrastructure. This comprehensive package, valued at $348, is available for instant download, empowering creators to start selling their digital products globally without restrictions.
Your Deployment Checklist

To start selling digital products sovereignly, begin by setting up your hosting with GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, configure your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate tasks. Then, integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing and Supabase or Google Sheets for secure order storage. Finally, set up Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for efficient file delivery, ensuring a seamless customer experience. By following these steps, creators can deploy their sovereign digital commerce stack and start selling their products globally.
